title: Center for American Archeology Museum

services.name: Class
services.desc: Our Adult Field School is your opportunity to be an archaeologist. Undergraduates, graduate students, and adults of all ages are welcome! Join our field crew and participate in real archaeological research alongside professional archaeologists. With our staff, you will learn how to do fieldwork, laboratory work, identify artifacts, and more as we investigate the German site. The German Site is a Late Woodland / Jersey Bluff Phase habitation site located on a colluvial slope in the Crawford Creek valley. The site was occupied approximately 800-1200 CE. services.desc: Due to the extreme flooding in Calhoun county, we will be cancelling the Eco Adventure Day Camp for both June and July. All of our other programs are still open! We will still have all field schools including High School Field School, Adult Field School, and the ASU Field School as well as our REU program. In addition, Friday Archaeology, a free program for K-3rd graders, will still be held. The location has moved to the old Kampsville school instead of the Museum.
